description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Syndra''' conjures a ''Dark Sphere'' at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The ''Dark Sphere'' then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
description.text: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

description2.raw: '''[[File:Syndra Transcendent.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Transcendent|An icon for Syndra's ability Transcendent]] [[Syndra#Transcendent|Transcendent]] Bonus:''' Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes '''Syndra''' to periodically [[stock]] a ''Dark Sphere'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
description2.text: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
90 / 125 / 160 / 195 / 230 (+ 70% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Dark Sphere'' can be conjured inside terrain, but cannot be thrown there with [[File:Syndra Force of Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Force of Will|An icon for Syndra's ability Force of Will]] [[Syndra#Force of Will|Force of Will]]. * There is no limit as to how many ''Dark Spheres'' can be active at a time. * After '''Syndra''' gains the [[File:Syndra Transcendent.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Transcendent|An icon for Syndra's ability Transcendent]] [[Syndra#Transcendent|Transcendent]] bonus, the number of ''Dark Sphere'' charges available is represented by small Sphere icons under her [[health bar]], visible to the player only.
notes.text:
Dark Sphere can be conjured inside terrain, but cannot be thrown there with Force of Will.
There is no limit as to how many Dark Spheres can be active at a time.
After Syndra gains the Transcendent bonus, the number of Dark Sphere charges available is represented by small Sphere icons under her health bar, visible to the player only.
